quest.title: Garcia's Paean: The Echo of Someone
quest.description: There seems to be someone new by Garcia's side...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: T—Traveler! You're just in time. I was just about to go back to work after this coffee break with Ms. Kaia. Allow me to introduce you...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Ah, so you must be the Traveler Garcia's been talking about. It's a pleasure to meet you, I'm Kaia, a... um... well, I dance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello, Garcia mentioned you before, I believe.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Hehe, is that so? I'm happy to hear that. I was beginning to think that he commits nothing but his machine and Lutong to memory.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: You can safely exclude me from this, Ma'am. I believe that this shall be to Mr. Garcia's liking, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Now, that wouldn't do. Without you, Garcia would surely find himself penniless in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Forgive me, Ma'am, if I must disagree. I am certain that Mr. Garcia would save up for two cups of coffee, no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Make that three cups!

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: You display most astonishing empathy, Mr. Garcia.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Well, b—back to business! Now, Traveler, I am still in need of the insignias that the Treasure Hoarders carry with them. Should you find any, do consider selling them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I have... earned some Mora recently. So you need not fret about your payment.

talks.objective: Obtain Treasures Hoarders' insignias for Garcia

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Did you get the insignias?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Hmm... These should suffice for my research.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Here's your payment. Do accept it, if you would be so kind...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler, why are you giving me that look? You're making me nervous.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Ahem! I am going back to work now. Yes, back to work...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Oh! These insignias look to be of high quality!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Here's your payment. Do kindly accept this...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler, why are you giving me that look? You're making me nervous.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Ahem! I am going back to work now. Yes, back to work...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Hello? Um... What would you like to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you get to know Mr. Garcia?

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Cutting straight to the chase, huh? As befits an adventurer, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: I got to meet Garcia because... our troupe director hired him as an accountant.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Haha, to be honest, I have never seen anyone quite so incompatible with our troupe.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: We were playing music, dancing, drinking, and singing, and there he was on the sidelines, doing his calculations in silence with Lutong.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: There was a time when I saw him in strange clothes that had some drawings on it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: I was curious and asked about the drawing. He said that it was the blueprint of a machine.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: He said he drew on his outfit because he happened to have neither pen nor paper when he was telling someone about the machine.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: As such, he used coal to draw on his own outfit to demonstrate and explain the blueprint.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Then we spent a lot of time talking about that outfit and his machine... And, of course, he did most of the talking, while I was the listener.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Hehe, he really is a weirdo but... he is also quite the charmer.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: This should be a good thing, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: (Etiquette, etiquette! For goodness' sake, don't forget your etiquette!)

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: (Should I tell Mr. Garcia that his features are contorted...?)
